# P35.36 — statements files, `upstream_href` and the provenance panel

**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/315_P35.36__statements-files-and-provenance-panel.md`
(manifest row **315**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B — `R11-K13-TX-08a`).
Invoked `live_verification=false` — committed code + tests only; **no
deploy, no production mutation, no publication/release gate, no
connector or registry flip, no merge to main**. Requirement stamps:
**SIG-TRANSP-011** (*Per-claim provenance panel* — the §56.10 `Owner:`
line names this row) · cited: **SIG-TRANSP-012** (*View original* —
Owner P36.51; this row emits the J3 §5.3 label states and never mints
a raw-byte link), **SIG-TRANSP-025** (*JSON twins / API parity* —
Owner P37.42; the panel names the path `unavailable`-typed meanwhile),
**SIG-TRANSP-022** (the P35.31 scrub every upstream field passes),
**SIG-UI-028** (the claim viewer this contract feeds), **SIG-UI-035**
(release-pinned addressing the `#claim-<id>` anchors ride). Draft
design ref (not stamped): **UXR-33** (K13 §7 W1 — one provenance
contract across surfaces). **Base:**
`r11/P35.65-withbase-helper-and-containment-check` · **Gate:** none —
the plan cell carries no gate.

## The problem

J1 §B.4 + NEW-10 measured it: the claim spine already resolved every
published claim's evidence binding, but the export pipeline built the
`record_claims` stream and then *dropped* it — no statements artifact
shipped, `published_record.py` hard-coded
`source_refs[].upstream_href = None`, and no public surface could show
per-claim provenance. K13's UX synthesis (§7 W1, UXR-33) demands ONE
provenance contract across every consumer; J3 §5.1 supplies the four
binding states verbatim; C4 NEW-2 is the standing lesson that an
absent binding must never be dressed as a document.

## What landed

- **`exports/src/exports/statements.py`** — the `sig.statement/1`
  row builder. One row per published claim, compartment placement
  exactly `_record_claims`'s (same licence gate, ODbL claims never in
  a CC-BY file). `value` is always the closed token `not_published`.
  Every upstream reference passes `policy.transparency.scrub_source_url`
  (the P35.31 S-6 gate): `full_url` only for `raw-ok`/`derived-only`
  lanes whose gate passed; `host_only` + `path_sha256` otherwise;
  `no_upstream_url_recorded` when none was recorded;
  `withheld_by_policy` when the host itself cannot publish (IP
  literal or sealed Part VIII class). A raw URL is never copied
  through. An unknown `binding_status` fails to `not_recorded`, never
  leaks an unvetted label (S-12).
- **`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`** — two new query inputs
  (`claim_provenance` for supersession/directness/epistemics/recorded
  run+at, `claim_binding_detail` for the capture ⋈ artifact ⋈
  extraction join), the source-registry lane map, and the
  per-compartment `statements.jsonl` write; a spine predating the
  P32.2 binding columns degrades to `not_recorded` rows, never a
  guessed `legacy_synthetic`.
- **`exports/src/exports/manifest.py`** — optional `schema` /
  `row_count` / `distinct_entities` on manifest artifacts; the
  statements entries carry `sig.statement/1` + real counts.
- **`exports/src/exports/release.py`** — the immutable release copies
  `<comp>/statements.jsonl` to `r/<pub>/c/<comp>/statements.jsonl`;
  `_claim_index` reads statements first, `record_claims` second
  (pre-P35.36 exports keep working).
- **`exports/src/exports/published_record.py`** —
  `PROJECTION_VERSION` → `sig.published-record/4`; records embed the
  statement rows as `claim_statements`, and
  `source_refs[].upstream_href`/`upstream_host`/`upstream_status` fill
  from the statement's S-6-gated upstream object — J1 NEW-10's
  hard-coded `None` is gone.
- **`exports/src/exports/provenance_panel.py`** + **`release_pages.py`**
  — the Python twin of the shared contract, rendered on released
  record pages: one panel per claim, `#claim-<id>` resolving to the
  panel itself, claim tables linking the anchor, a statements-file
  link where the artifact exists, `not_recorded` panels for claims
  with no published statement.
- **`web/src/lib/provenance-panel.ts`** — the `sig.provenance-panel/1`
  TypeScript contract: the verbatim J3 §5.1 wording (the
  `legacy_synthetic` run-level sentence never implies a per-record
  copy), `panelFromStatement`/`panelForClaim` normalisers, the named
  absence vocabulary (`not_recorded`, `no_upstream_url_recorded`,
  `not_publishable`, `unavailable`, `Not yet independently reviewed`),
  locale-grouped byte counts (K14 NEW-8), every internal href through
  `withBase()` with relative arguments (P35.65 — zero new
  root-absolute sites).
- **`web/src/components/ProvenancePanel.tsx`** — the one component;
  static-renders under Astro (`renderToStaticMarkup` in tests) and
  inside the React islands; `anchor` toggles the `id="claim-<id>"`.
- **`web/src/lib/statements-fixture.ts`** — committed fixture rows
  exercising all four binding states + the absence fifth.
- **`web/src/lib/data.ts`** — `getStatementIndex()`: fixtures mode
  returns the committed rows; export mode scans every compartment's
  `<exportDir>/<comp>/statements.jsonl`; a pre-P35.36 export yields an
  EMPTY index — honest absence, never a fixture fallback, never a
  build error. Withdrawn claims are filtered.
- **Consumers** — `pages/evidence/[id].astro` (the claim viewer),
  `pages/network.astro` + `components/NetworkEdgeItem.astro` (edge
  rows link `#claim-<id>` to ONE deduplicated "Claim provenance"
  section — a claim may back several edges; the dedupe keeps the
  `/network/` document inside its gzip budget),
  `islands/NetworkIsland.tsx` (receives the lean statement rows, not
  rendered panels, and normalises absent claims in-island to
  `not_recorded`), `islands/MapIsland.tsx` (the selection pane renders
  the record JSON's embedded `claim_statements`, bounded at 8 panels
  with the remainder linked on the record page; pre-P35.36 records
  carry none — honest absence).

## Out of scope (named owners)

- **The "view original" byte routes** — P36.51 (SIG-TRANSP-012's
  owner). This row emits the §5.3 label states only; the panel never
  mints a raw-byte link on its own.
- **JSON twin / API parity implementation** — P37.42 + P35.57
  (SIG-TRANSP-025): the panel names the path, `unavailable`-typed
  meanwhile.
- **Per-claim pages** — never generated (2.42 M claims; J3 G-10); the
  capped claim viewer is the only per-claim surface.
- **Connectors, `ingestion_permitted` flips, publication/release
  mutation, live systems** — untouched by contract.

## Verification

- `uv run pytest tests/exports` — **900 passed** (20 new
  `test_statements.py` cases: S-6 full/host-only/withheld/no-url
  forms, all four binding states verbatim + `not_recorded`, ODbL
  compartment separation, `not_published` value, release-tree
  statements + `_claim_index` preference + fallback, panel markup and
  `#claim-<id>` anchors, named-absence panels, grouped byte counts).
- `npm --prefix web run check` — **green end to end**: `astro check`
  0 errors/0 warnings/0 hints; vitest **36 files / 427 tests** (14 new
  `provenance-panel.test.ts`: verbatim wording, contract completeness
  — all 16 §5.2 field labels and no blank `<dd>`, the S-6 upstream
  forms, `withBase()` links, cross-surface identical-contract render);
  `astro build` 32 pages; `check:licenses` green; **`check:paths` —
  containment holds, 168 raw / 160 counted vs the recorded baseline,
  no growth**; playwright **322 passed** (chromium + no-JS, axe WCAG
  2.2 AA — incl. the network/map/search budget specs).
- `make check` — green (ruff + format + mypy 375 files; the pytest
  suite; verify-gen). Local run armed with the `SIG_GCP_PROJECT`
  sentinel per the fail-closed leak-check contract (OP-07);
  unarmed, that one check reds — base-identical, CI arms it via
  `vars.SIG_GCP_PROJECT`.
- Determinism: statement rows derive only from spine reads; the
  byte-size grouping uses `toLocaleString("en-US")` / `format(,)` on
  the Python twin — no locale drift between renders.
